title: HDB feedback on condensation and mould from neighbours' air-conditioning use
asked: Ms Jessica Tan asked how many cases HDB received in 2025 about condensation and mould on walls or ceilings caused by neighbours' continuous air-conditioning use, and whether HDB would require flat owners to carry out wall or ceiling enhancements as part of preventive maintenance.
response: HDB received about 240 such cases of feedback in 2025. On receiving feedback, HDB inspects to determine the cause and advises flat owners and neighbours, including on how air-conditioners are being used, and recommends keeping rooms well-ventilated and using mould-resistant paint. On the suggestion of wall and ceiling enhancements, HDB has to explore whether these enhancements truly work and would look at specific circumstances and cases, including how compensation can best be shared between the two individuals where egregious use has caused damage.

key_points.point: HDB received about 240 cases of feedback in 2025 on condensation and mould on walls or ceilings arising from neighbours' air-conditioner use.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: In 2025, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) received a total of about 240 cases of feedback regarding condensation and mould on walls or ceilings arising from neighbours' use of air-conditioners.

key_points.point: HDB inspects to determine the cause of the condensation and mould and advises flat owners and neighbours, including on air-conditioner usage.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB will conduct inspections to determine the cause of the condensation and mould, and provide appropriate advice to the flat owners and neighbours

key_points.point: Flat owners are recommended to keep rooms well-ventilated and to consider mould-resistant paint as a preventive measure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: We also recommend flat owners to keep rooms well-ventilated to minimise mould growth and consider the use of mould-resistant paint as a preventive measure.

key_points.point: HDB can consider advising neighbours on proper air-conditioner usage, such as length of use or temperature settings.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB can consider providing an advisory to the neighbours on proper usage of air-conditioners

key_points.point: On wall and ceiling enhancements, HDB has to explore whether they will truly work.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB has to explore if these enhancements will truly work

key_points.point: Where egregious use has caused damage to a neighbour's flat, how compensation is shared would depend on the case specifics.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: we will have to see how the compensation can be best shared by the two individuals

left_open: Whether wall or ceiling enhancements would be made mandatory for flat owners who use air-conditioning continuously
Whether guidelines will be introduced to clarify the responsibilities of affected flat owners
How accountability, cost-sharing or timely resolution of condensation disputes between neighbours would work in cases other than those involving egregious use
supplementary: The MP followed up on mandating wall or ceiling enhancements, and on accountability, cost-sharing and guidelines for affected flat owners.
